correctness.rationale: Explicit positive probability weights give exact centered covariance with four checked spectral classes on the full 2(rs-1)-dimensional affine hull. Direct vertex projections yield exactly two inverse-covariance quadratic forms, whose equality is equivalent to a unique-root polynomial; their weighted trace is the dimension. Global trace-determinant inequality proves containment optimality and uniqueness without symmetry assumptions. Algebra gives intrinsic volume ratio and fixed-r limit; exact-rational identities and 25 numeric full-vertex cases support the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The theorem determines a natural exact Euclidean invariant of an infinite complete multipartite family introduced for PQ adjacency polytopes. Its all-contact optimal measure has a sharp uniformity boundary at class size two. The positive limiting ellipsoid-to-ball volume ratio for r>=3 is a qualitative structural divide from the credited r=2 case where the ratio vanishes. This nontrivial asymptotic and explicit four-mode geometry are not mere parameter substitutions of the earlier two-part formula.
